designs.name: 霜璃王冠
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW premium fantasy weapon illustration for choosing an ice bow design, design 1 of 3: THE RIME SOVEREIGN. This is lavish finished concept art, not a low-poly model, not a schematic or a game screenshot. One spectacular bow made ENTIRELY of crystalline ice, including the grip. No metal, wood, leather, or gold. A graceful regal silhouette: long flowing recurved limbs with sculptural twisted ice channels, thin crystalline lacework and open architectural cavities nested within the limbs, swept crown-like fans of large clear crystals at the two tips. Intricate but controlled hierarchy: a few large elegant shapes, beautiful mid-sized interlocking facets, minute frozen fern tracery and internal frost veins. Smooth narrow crystalline grip genuinely connected to both limbs; a luminous teardrop crystal cradled just above the grip, surrounded by a small broken crystalline coronet. Bowstring as one thin silver-white frost filament spanning between the two limb tips. Palette: nearly colorless optical ice, luminous pearl-white edges, VERY subtle pale lavender inner depths and occasional mint aurora reflections, NO saturated blue wash. Rich believable transparent material, sharp specular highlights, internal refraction, cloudy frost inclusions, strong material depth. Exquisite high-end fantasy illustration with cinematic product-shot lighting. Portrait 2:3 composition, show the entire upright bow, both tips and string fully inside generous margins, slight three-quarter angle so thickness and carving are visible. Bow fills most of the frame. Dark smoky charcoal background with faint frozen dust only, restrained halo light to separate clear ice, no landscape clutter, no people, no arrow, no text, no watermark. Must look like an ancient beautiful elemental royal artifact; NEVER like a simple stick with identical spikes attached. Avoid repetitive comb teeth, opaque plastic, flat white surfaces, blurry glow covering craftsmanship.

designs.name: 冰龙脊骨
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW finished fantasy weapon illustration, design 2 of 3: FROST WYRM'S SPINE. One intimidating monumental ice bow with a predatory dragon-inspired silhouette, made ENTIRELY of ice, not actual bone, no metal, leather, wood, gold, or a living dragon. This is an elaborate premium fantasy game concept painting, NOT a simple low-poly model. Thick swept-back recurved limbs resembling the curved spinal armor of a frozen ancient wyrm: layered translucent ice vertebrae interlock with large blade-like ice scales, jagged frost-white ridges and a few huge swept ice horns. Strong asymmetry of detail while maintaining balanced upper/lower limb masses. The upper limb terminates in a highly sculpted ICE DRAGON HEAD, jaws partly open with icicle teeth, an elegant backward horn and luminous pale eye slit; the lower limb ends in an armored hooked tail-claw of crystalline ice. The creature motifs must form the bow itself, no separate creature. Central grip is a smooth, narrow dark-clear ice handle framed by larger crystalline guards; the inward side has a clean arrow clearance. A thin taut glowing frost string clearly connects the two tips. Rich color: deep smoky petrol/teal-blue glacial interiors, opaque chalk-white hoarfrost on exposed ridges, brilliant colorless fractured facets, tiny turquoise light in deep cracks. Avoid uniformly saturated blue, avoid neon. Emphasize thick glassy ice depth, trapped bubbles, stress cracks, frost dust collecting between interlocking scales, intricate exquisite carving and dramatic surface layering. A few small drifting ice splinters only. Portrait 2:3 full weapon shot, bow upright at a slight diagonal, entire bow and both tips inside generous margins, shallow three-quarter perspective showing thickness. Dark graphite background, cold hard rim light and subtle mist behind the weapon, crisp dramatic studio-like lighting, no excessive bloom obscuring silhouette. No people, no hands, no arrow, no labels or watermark. This must feel savage, ancient, powerful and visually complex rather than ornate delicate elven lace. No repeated identical comb spikes, no flat blue plastic.

designs.name: 极光神谕
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW finished premium fantasy weapon illustration, design 3 of 3: AURORA ORACLE. An otherworldly magical ice bow assembled from LEVITATING CRYSTAL SECTIONS, visually radically different from a conventional solid spiked bow. All tangible components are crystalline ice; no metal, gold, leather, wood, machinery, cables or sci-fi gun parts. The central narrow ergonomic grip is a sculpted ice hourglass clasp with an opalescent luminous crystal above it, entirely made of ice. Upper and lower limbs each composed of four magnificent curved sculptural crystal crescents which float in a graceful recurve arc, with conspicuous dark air gaps between adjacent pieces; fine ribbons of aurora energy and aligned frost sigils connect the gaps. The tangible shapes must still unmistakably trace ONE archery bow, with a thin luminous bowstring joining the upper and lower tips. Bow limbs have broad blade-like surfaces with extraordinarily fine etched snowflake mandalas, layered bevels, nested translucent crystal planes and prismatic edge splitting. Above the grip a spectacular open double halo of suspended sixfold snowflake-shaped shards surrounds the opal core, tilted slightly in depth, precise sacred geometry but asymmetrical shard sizes. Sparse little satellite ice prisms orbit only close to this core. Silhouette is graceful yet bold, geometrically architectural and weightless, NOT a stick with spikes, NOT a dragon, NOT a traditional elven bow. Color palette: pale translucent jade-mint and pearl-white ice, iridescent lilac and rose-violet spectral accents within the thicker prisms; opalescent polar light rather than saturated blue. Energy highlights are restrained; crystal thickness, intricate etched details and transparency remain clearly visible. Beautiful caustic glints, internal ice feathers and fine stress fractures. Very high craft and surface detail. Portrait 2:3 full weapon composition, entire bow and both tips fully visible with generous margins, slight three-quarter view revealing floating layers, dark nearly black violet studio backdrop, faint polar light haze far behind the object, no distracting scenery. A few delicate magical frost motes; no explosion, no huge bloom, no people, no arrow, no typography, no watermark. Highly polished cinematic fantasy weapon concept art with convincing transparent crystal material; not low-poly, not flat plastic, not an engineering diagram.
